description: This file contains unit tests for the IPC Controller component in the Rialto server manager, using Google Test framework. It defines a test fixture class 'IpcTests' with methods to simulate IPC events, configure responses, and verify interactions with mocked dependencies.

classes.name: IpcTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for unit testing the IPC Controller component, providing setup, mock interactions, and utility methods for simulating IPC events and verifying behavior.

methods.name: configureServerToSendOkResponses
methods.description: Configures the mock server stub to send OK responses.

methods.name: configureServerToSendFailResponses
methods.description: Configures the mock server stub to send failure responses.

methods.name: simulateStateChangedEventInactive
methods.description: Simulates a state changed event indicating inactive state.

methods.name: simulateAckEvent
methods.description: Simulates an acknowledgment event with predefined ping ID and success status.

methods.name: sessionServerAppManagerWillBeNotifiedAboutCompletedHealthcheck
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server app manager will be notified about a completed health check.

methods.name: waitForExpectationsMet
methods.description: Waits until the expectations flag is set, indicating that expected events occurred.

methods.name: triggerCreateClientConnectToFakeSocket
